title: Degree-zero cohomology and the degree-zero pullback map
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $G$ an abelian sheaf on $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and let $H^q(T_{\Et},G)$ be the cohomology of [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], computed from a K-injective resolution $s:G\to I^\bullet$ [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions].

1. (Degree zero.) The map $\epsilon_{T,G}:G(T)\to\mathcal H^0(\Gamma(T,I^\bullet))=H^0(T_{\Et},G)$, $g\mapsto$ the class of $s(g)\in I^0(T)$, is well defined (it lands in the degree-$0$ cocycles) and is an isomorphism of abelian groups. It is natural in $G$ (for $\varphi:G\to G'$, $H^0(\varphi)\circ\epsilon_{T,G}=\epsilon_{T,G'}\circ\varphi(T)$, with $H^0(\varphi)$ as in [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial]) and compatible with the identifications between different choices of $I^\bullet$ [prop-weil-pbc-cohomology-resolution-independent].
2. (Pullback in degree zero.) Let $u:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes, $G$ an abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$, $u^{-1}$ the inverse image with unit $\eta_u:\mathrm{id}\to u_*u^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and $u^*:H^0(X_{\Et},G)\to H^0(Y_{\Et},u^{-1}G)$ the pullback map of [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] in degree $0$. Then
$$u^*\circ\epsilon_{X,G}=\epsilon_{Y,u^{-1}G}\circ\eta_{u,G}(X),$$
where $\eta_{u,G}(X):G(X)\to(u_*u^{-1}G)(X)=(u^{-1}G)(Y)$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is the unit on global sections. In words: under $H^0=\Gamma$ the degree-zero pullback map is "pull back the global section".
